CurriculumPilotEntryGate.title: Short self-assessment before entering the module
CurriculumPilotEntryGate.description: Before your first access to the learning materials, you can complete a short starting self-assessment. It helps compare your self-assessment before and after using the curriculum.
CurriculumPilotEntryGate.fillDescription: Complete the starting self-assessment to record your confidence before using the modules. This step is optional for everyone.
CurriculumPilotEntryGate.error: We could not save your decision. Please try again.

skipModal.title: Skip the starting self-assessment?
skipModal.description: You cannot complete PRE later in this learning cycle, but you can still take POST after completing at least one module. A PRE/POST comparison will not be available.

completed.title: Post-assessment has been saved
completed.description: Your closing self-assessment has been saved. You can continue studying the remaining modules and working towards a certificate.

available.title: Ready to finish learning? Take POST
available.description: You have completed at least one module. When you are ready to finish this learning cycle, submit the closing self-assessment. You can still study more modules afterwards.

locked.title: Post-assessment will be available after completing at least one module
locked.description: Complete at least one module before taking the closing self-assessment.

errors.timeout: Certificate generation took too long. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: Unable to generate the certificate right now.

common.validationError: Please answer all questions before continuing.

pre.title: Self-assessment before starting the IntegratESG modules
pre.description: Before starting the IntegratESG modules, please indicate how confident you currently feel about the following ESG-related tasks. There are no right or wrong answers. Your responses will help us measure learning progress.
pre.submitError: We could not save your pre-assessment. Please try again.

post.title: Self-assessment after using the IntegratESG modules
post.description: After using the IntegratESG modules, indicate how confident you feel about these ESG tasks. If you skipped PRE, your POST result will be saved without a PRE/POST comparison.
post.submitError: We could not save your post-assessment. Please try again.

CurriculumPilotFocusModules.title: Pilot focus modules
CurriculumPilotFocusModules.description: To help us evaluate all six modules fairly, these two are your recommended focus.
CurriculumPilotFocusModules.openAccess: All six modules remain available. These recommendations do not prevent you from exploring others.
